title: Field Notes
subtitle: a gallery of working instruments
body: Small, complete machines that demonstrate one idea each, in the browser, with no dependencies: a kintsugi circuit breaker that renders its own failure history as visible golden seams; a Physarum-inspired routing solver that grows a network backbone and shows every candidate edge it discarded; a decision-telemetry tree that keeps the clean record and its buried shadow on the same screen. Each one is the thesis at demo scale: the break is the record, not the failure.
note: Self-contained HTML instruments · no build step
